description: This Baseus Aramid Fiber Braiding USB-C to Lightning Cable PD 20W is a high-quality cable that is perfect for charging your Apple devices. With a length of 100 cm, this cable is long enough to reach your device from a distance. The aramid fiber braiding ensures that the cable is durable and can withstand daily wear and tear. The PD 20W charging technology ensures that your device charges quickly and efficiently. This cable is compatible with USB-C and Lightning ports, making it versatile and easy to use. It is a must-have accessory for anyone who wants to keep their Apple devices charged and ready to go.
highlights: Baseus Aramid Fiber Braiding USB-C to Lightning Cable
PD 20W fast charging for your Apple devices
Durable and sturdy with aramid fiber braiding
Compatible with USB-C and Lightning devices
Ideal for mobiles and tablets accessories
The Baseus brand cable was created with Apple device users in mind. Thanks to a smart chip, it allows fast charging with a maximum power of up to 27W. It also allows data transmission at 480 Mbps.
The product is distinguished by its original design, and its length is 1 meters

The design of the Baseus cable uses aramid braided fiber, which is used in the military and aerospace industries. This makes the product extremely durable and resistant to mechanical damage. It also successfully passed a number of tests
The product was made in the USB 2.0 standard, ensuring data transfer speeds of up to 480 Mb/
Material: TPE + aramid fiber + zinc alloy
